description: Close the owned GDB process after verifying the inferior state. When one live thread group has a verified durable output TTY, BinSight automatically detaches it, which may resume target execution; otherwise close reports that a disposition is required. BinSight never kills attached or remote targets as part of debugger cleanup. In a shared MCP server, this admitted close retires any active binary-analysis session; after target effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first.
name: close_gdb_session
title: Close Gdb Session
